dedupe_keys.name: gsm cover builder qgis plugin for coverage plans from localities

description: GSM Cover Builder is a small plugin for the open-source QGIS geographic information system that generates mobile coverage plans from a set of localities and a chosen coverage radius. Aimed at geomarketing professionals, it analyses and visualises proximity relationships between localities and works out the minimum number of GSM sites needed to cover them, giving a first estimate of how many sites an operator would need to serve a region and where they might go. It does not model radio propagation, terrain or capacity; coverage is represented by circles of the given radius. Version 0.1 was published in March 2025 and version 0.2.0 on 5 September 2026, for QGIS 3.0 and later, with about 1,500 downloads in total, and the code is on GitHub. Coverage: any region with locality points. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): MIT. Access is free of charge. Caveats: a simple geometric covering method, useful for screening only; maintained by one author. Simulation uses: quick capacity planning of rural coverage and estimating the sites needed to restore basic service to settlements after outages. Related records: QNetPlanner optimises gateway placement with integer programming, and RadioPlanner and Signal-Server model propagation.
